title: Happy Choice
text: Happy Choice. I purchased these frames to hold small works of art.  They were fine for my needs.  A point to remember -- although the frame can be hung either vertically or horizontally, the table stand only accommodates the vertical position.

product_metadata.title: LaVie Home 5x7 Picture Frames (2 Pack, White) Simple Designed Photo Frame with High Definition Glass for Wall Mount & Table Top Display, Set of 2 Classic Collection
features: SIMPLISTIC LINE DESIGN - LaVie Home 5 x 7 white picture frame has a clean lines and minimalist design that it looks bright and tasteful, fits any decor,whether it's modern or vintage.
PREMIUM QUALITY - Crafted by Durable PS (acrylic-resin) molding construction, clean lines with attractively finished. Every frame is made with perfect attention to detail.
WALL MOUNT or TABLE TOP- With triangular hangers already installed on the backpanel, simply hang it on a wall hanger to easily hang artwork or photos, either vertically or horizontally.

PACKAGE INCLUDES - Set of 2 black frames, fits standard 5x7 pictures, photos, prints, with real glass to protect against dust and moisture. Tips: wall hooks or fasteners are not included in the package.
PROTECTIVE PACKAGING - Proprietary packaging helps ensure the safe delivery of fragile items.
